entities.summary: Dan Mullins is an English metal drummer. He is most known for being the drummer of the doom metal band My Dying Bride. Mullins has cited drummers such as Buddy Rich, Mike Portnoy, Sean Reinert, and Paul Mazurkiewicz as influences.
